headline: He's a great communicator and consistently delivered high-quality work for us that really made an impact.
quote: Ben was a big asset to our marketing efforts. As a venture-backed startup, things move fast, and we needed a variety of enablement assets to support our sales efforts. Ben was nimble and handled a lot for us, including case studies, datasheets, website content, and decks... end to end, from copy to final design. He's a great communicator and consistently delivered high-quality work for us that really made an impact.
name: Diego Asenjo
